segments.an4.126:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
segments.an4.126:1.4: So yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.
segments.an4.126:1.5: So kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā suddhāvāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
segments.an4.126:2.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idhekacco puggalo karuṇā … pe … muditā … pe … upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ.
segments.an4.126:2.3: Iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
segments.an4.126:2.4: So yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.
segments.an4.126:2.5: So kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā suddhāvāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
segments.an4.126:2.7: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.

lines: 125-126. Pañcame paṭhamajjhānavasena mettā, dutiyādivasena karuṇādayo dassitā.
124-6. Catutthe te dhammeti te “rūpagatan”tiādinā nayena vutte rūpādayo dhamme.
Aniccatoti iminā niccappaṭikkhepato tesaṃ aniccatamāha, tato eva ca udayavayavantato vipariṇāmato tāvakālikato ca te aniccāti jotitaṃ hoti.
Jarāya maraṇena ca tadeva viparītaṃ, ittarakkhaṇameva ca hotīti.
Tato eva ca abhiṇhappaṭipīḷanato dukkhavatthuto ca te dukkhāti jotitaṃ hoti.
Udayavayavantatāya hi te abhiṇhappaṭipīḷanato nirantaradukkhatāya dukkhasseva ca adhiṭṭhānabhūtā.
Rūpādidhammā hi na ettha attā atthīti anattā.
Tena abyāpārato nirīhato tucchato anattāti dīpitaṃ hoti.
Lakkhaṇattayameva sukhāvabodhanatthaṃ ekādasahi padehi vibhajitvā gahitanti dassetuṃ “tatthā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
